caption: Mr. Samarth Hegde, a second-semester Civil Engineering student has earned a prestigious selection for the Vizzy Trophy. This follows his standout performance in the South Zone Inter-University Men’s Cricket Championship 2025-26 at JSS STU, where he secured 2nd place and advanced to the All India Inter University Men’s cricket championship 2026. Samarth will now represent his region at the Panjim Gymkhana Ground, Goa, from March 1st to 5th, 2026.
